### 🔵 Needs a closer look The URL filter accepts unusable IPv6 destinations such as `::1`, causing the installer to open its own computer instead of falling back to the discovered device’s LAN address. **No open issues** 🎉
1 previously missed issue In code that hasn't changed since last review
Reject unusable IPv6 internal URLs before falling back to the LAN address `crates/​hai-core/​src/​discovery.rs:112` IPv6 literals bypass this filter because parsing them as `Ipv4Addr` fails and `is_none_or` accepts them. An announcement with a valid LAN address but `internal_url = "http://[::1]:8123/"` therefore opens the installer's own computer instead of the discovered device. Distinguish IPv6 literals from hostnames and reject unusable destinations, including loopback, unscoped link-local, and unreachable IPv4-mapped addresses, so the URL falls back to the discovered address.
